biografia.title: Biography
biografia.description: Learn more about Paulo Zefi's journey
biografia.subtitle: Forty years of research, passion and dedication to memory
biografia.role: Historian, Researcher, Keeper of Albanian Heritage
biografia.intro: With more than forty years dedicated to historical research, Paulin Zefi has become a reference figure in the study of medieval Albanian history and, in particular, the city of Lezha. His dedication has shed light on obscure periods of Albanian history.
biografia.archives: Through European archives, unpublished manuscripts and oral testimonies, he has reconstructed the complexity of the events that marked the Ottoman Empire and Albanian resistance.
biografia.mission: His mission is simple but profound: to preserve the memory of Lezha and pass it on to future generations, so that they do not forget the sacrifices and glory of those who defended this land.
